svg.title: River Wharfe above Kettlewell: catchment, terrain, streams and gauges
svg.desc: Map of the 93 square kilometre catchment draining to the Kettlewell river level gauge in the Yorkshire Dales, delineated from Environment Agency LIDAR, with elevation bands, the derived stream network and four Environment Agency gauges.
svg.text: River Wharfe above Kettlewell, Yorkshire Dales
Catchment and streams derived by Beck & Call Digital from the Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM; gauge locations from Environment Agency hydrology data.
